resolveIncidents.name: resolveIncidents

closeIncidents.name: closeIncidents

assignIncidents.name: assignIncidents

setupInstructions.description:
### Webhook setup in Coralogix

1. In Coralogix, go to **Alerts** and open the alert definition you want.
2. Open **Outbound Webhooks** and click **Add webhook**.
3. Select **Generic webhook**.
4. In **Webhook URL**, paste: `{{webhookUrl}}`
5. Keep method as **POST** and content type as **application/json**.
6. Save the webhook, then trigger a test alert to verify events are received.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a configured Coralogix alert triggers and posts its outbound webhook to this flow, delivering the alert event (application, subsystem, severity, and matched fields). Requires the generic outbound webhook to be set up on the alert in Coralogix.

newIncident.description: Triggers when a new incident appears in Coralogix. Polls on a schedule — ideal for paging on-call, creating Jira tickets, or posting to Slack.

severity.description: Only trigger for incidents with these severities. Leave empty for all.

aiMetadata.description: Fires for each newly triggered Coralogix incident, discovered by polling on a schedule; can be narrowed to specific severities. Represents a freshly opened incident the flow has not seen before — use to drive paging, ticketing, or notifications.

nl.\n### Webhook setup in Coralogix\n\n1. I:
### Webhook setup in Coralogix

1. Ga in Coralogix naar **Waarschuwingen** en open de gewenste waarschuwingsdefinitie.
2. Open **Uitgaande Webhooks** en klik op **Voeg webhook toe**.
3. Selecteer **Generic webhook**.
4. In **Webhook URL**, plakken: `{{webhookUrl}}`
5. Houd de methode als **POST** en het inhoudstype als **application/json**.
6. Sla de webhook op, en trigger vervolgens een testwaarschuwing om te controleren of de gebeurtenissen zijn ontvangen.

1. In Coralogix, go to **Alerts** and open the alert definition you want.
2. Open **Outbound Webhooks** and click **Add webhook**.
3. Select **Generic webhook**.
4. In **Webhook URL**, paste: `{{webhookUrl}}`
5. Keep method as **POST** and content type as **application/json**.
6. Save the webhook, then trigger a test alert to verify events are received.

pt.\n### Webhook setup in Coralogix\n\n1. I:
### Configuração do Webhook em Coralogix

1. Em Coralogix, vá em **Alertas** e abra a definição de alerta que você deseja.
2. Abra **Outbound Webhooks** e clique **Add webhook**.
3. Selecione **Generic webhook**.
4. Em **URL do Webhook**, colar: `{{webhookUrl}}`
5. Mantenha o método como **POST** e o tipo de conteúdo como **application/json**.
6. Salve o webhook, em seguida, acione um alerta de teste para verificar se os eventos estão recebidos.
